definitions.explanation: The act of creating or drawing up a plan, proposal, or strategy. Used in business, government, and project management contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立案|りつあん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立案|りつあん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立案|りつあん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took half a year from planning the project to its execution.

notes:
USAGE:
{立案|りつあん} refers to the initial stage of creating a plan or proposal. It is more formal than ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ and is often used in organizational or governmental contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立案|りつあん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to draft a policy)
- {立案者|りつあんしゃ} (planner, author of a plan)
- {立案|りつあん}⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧ (planning stage)
- ⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧{立案|りつあん} (project planning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧ focuses on conceiving creative projects or events, while {立案|りつあん} focuses on the formal drafting of plans and strategies. {策定|さくてい} is an even more formal term for establishing official policies.
